cases.name: D09_RouteVisitsFourQuadrants
cases.conditionsAndExpectedResult: [Test] public void D09_RouteVisitsFourQuadrants(){o.StartTour();foreach(int x in new[]{-1,1})foreach(int z in new[]{-1,1})Assert.That(o.TourWaypoints.Any(p=>p.x*x>20&&p.z*z>20),Is.True);}

cases.name: E09_WetRoadColorSurvivesCityView
cases.conditionsAndExpectedResult: [Test] public void E09_WetRoadColorSurvivesCityView(){Draw(0,0,0,0);var road=app.World.transform.Find("East west avenue").GetComponent<Renderer>();var dry=road.sharedMaterial.color;Draw(40,40,30,1);app.Spatial.SetOverlay(DistrictOverlay.Normal);Assert.That(road.sharedMaterial.color.r,Is.LessThan(dry.r));var block=new MaterialPropertyBlock();road.GetPropertyBlock(block);Assert.That(block.isEmpty,Is.True);}

cases.name: F04_DrainageHighlightsRealChannels

cases.name: G05_ReloadDisposesOldWorld
cases.conditionsAndExpectedResult: [UnityTest] public IEnumerator G05_ReloadDisposesOldWorld(){var old=app.World;yield return SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync("Dhara");yield return null;Assert.That(old==null,Is.True);app=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<DharaApplication>();app.Weather.CancelRequests();app.AirQuality.Cancel();Assert.That(Object.FindObjectsByType<DharaApplication>(FindObjectsSortMode.None).Length,Is.EqualTo(1));}

cases.name: S21_ContinuousNavigationReachesFourFrontages
cases.conditionsAndExpectedResult: [Test] public void S21_ContinuousNavigationReachesFourFrontages(){o.EnterExplorer(Vector3.zero);foreach(var target in new[]{new Vector3(-50,2.2f,0),new Vector3(-50,2.2f,-32),new Vector3(0,2.2f,-32),new Vector3(50,2.2f,-32),new Vector3(50,2.2f,32),new Vector3(0,2.2f,32),new Vector3(-50,2.2f,32)}){for(int i=0;i<800&&Vector3.Distance(o.transform.position,target)>.4f;i++){var d=target-o.transform.position;o.MoveExplorer(new Vector2(d.x,d.z).normalized,.05f,true);}Assert.That(Vector3.Distance(o.transform.position,target),Is.LessThan(.5f));}}

cases.name: S23_RainParticlesReachStreetHeight
cases.conditionsAndExpectedResult: [Test] public void S23_RainParticlesReachStreetHeight(){o.EnterExplorer(new Vector3(0,2.2f,-34));Draw(100,0);var p=P("Rainfall particles");p.Simulate(3,true,true);var particles=new ParticleSystem.Particle[p.main.maxParticles];int n=p.GetParticles(particles);Assert.That(particles.Take(n).Any(x=>x.position.y<5&&Mathf.Abs(x.position.x)<10&&Mathf.Abs(x.position.z+34)<10),Is.True);}
